Name: Petite's Alex Remake
Author: Petite1002
Description:
[size=3][b]I figured some people might want to use the seasonal clothes that I already had, so I added the option to use it. Just download the main mod and have fun![/b][/size]
[size=2]I tested it and didn't find bugs, but please do tell me if you find any.[/size]
[size=2][u][color=#00ffff]I'm not planning on making more clothes to fit the SO Cute for the time being[/color][/u], but I can leave the clothes that fit some of the SO cute's styles in an optional file and if someone wants to adapt the missing clothes to my sprite, you have my permission to do so, but you CAN'T repost my assets, just add new ones and put mine as a depedency. Contact me if you have any questions.
[/size]
[size=3][b]What this mod does:
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Changes Alex's vanilla sprites to my version of him
[*]Gives him seasonal and 2 festival clothes (Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve) (configurable. Default = true)
[*]Makes him wear his swimsuit on summers when at the beach (configurable, default is [i]False[/i]. Will not work on festivals)
[i]NOTE: This option will also change the portrait, so keep it [u]False[/u] if you use any portraits mod

[/i][/list][b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][size=4]:[/size][/b]
This mod won't work with mods that also changes Alex's sprites
The portrait change with the "use swimsuit on any beach" might not work properly if you use portraits mods that change Alex's portrait. You can easly prevent that by keeping this option false, as said before.
To use it with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, make sure to turn SlightlyCuterAlex to false in the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic's configs.

[b][size=3]Installation[/size][size=4]:[/size][/b]
You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915http://]Content Patcher[/url] for this mod to work
Just extract the file somewhere and drag the [b](CP) Alex Remake[/b] to you Mods folder and enjoy! :)
The seasonal clothes are on by default, but you can turn off in the configs, setting it to false.

[b][size=3]Uninstall[/size][size=4]:[/size]
[/b]Just delete the (CP) Alex Remake folder from your Mods folder.

[size=3][b]Credits and thanks:[/b]
[/size][size=2]A huge thanks to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] [/b]for their incredible mods[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url] [/b]and[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], [/b]witch I adapted the flower dancing attire and got inspired for the hair's front view, and for their open permission in using their assets (seasonal version).
Also, another thanks to[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/64707721]CommanderWaddles[/url][/b] for their mod[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3388]Sexy Alex Muscular Sprite[/url], [/b]that inspired the hair's side view.
Many thanks to[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2816980]Alvadea[/url][/b], [b]Pereira1495 [/b]and[b] Ailin[/b] for giving me permission to use their spring and flower dance attire.

[/size]
Thank you for downloading my mod! Hope you like it!
